text:
infra-oncall: apiserver 503 spike in eu-west1, leader flaps in etcd observed ~02:14UTC. NAT/DNS egress errors correlated with GPU onboarding burst. alerting and investigating.

maria: seeing conntrack exhaustion on the nodes handling attach traffic, entries ~= 65k, kernel dropping new connections.

owen: confirmed etcd leadership changes every ~30s in the logs, peers disconnecting with io/timeouts. apiserver 503s line up with raft elections.

karthik: can we pin new GPU attaches to a dedicated attach pool to reduce controlplane fanout? gives us breathing room.

maria: bumping conntrack max on affected nodegroup now: `sysctl -w net.netfilter.nf_conntrack_max=262144`

asha: short-term thought: reduce controller-manager leader election sensitivity (increase lease duration) to tolerate transient disconnects, but that requires rollout.

owen: patching flags requires restart of controller-manager; prefer non-disruptive mitigations first (throttle attach events, clear conntrack).

infra-oncall: scaling apiserver replicas in eu-west1 by +2 and raising pod disruption budget temporarily. applying routing fallback for new attach requests.

sre-bot: Incident logged: INC-2026-234 for eu-west1 apiserver/etcd leader churn, paging infra-oncall.

maria: doing a rolling restart of kube-proxy on 6/8 nodes to purge conntrack and restore normal flow: `kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart daemonset/kube-proxy`

karthik: opened a temporary routing rule so model-serving traffic for new attaches in eu-west1 backs off to eu-central1 for 30m (will add cost note).

owen: running quick disk check on etcd VMs: `iostat -x 1 3` shows nvme iops spike and avg await ~50ms during the burst.

asha: recommend evicting non-critical system workloads off controlplane-proxy nodes and moving them to warm nodes while we drain attach bursts.

infra-oncall: mitigation summary: sysctl increased, kube-proxy restarted, apiserver replicas scaled, routing fallback set. monitoring 10m for stabilization.

maria: conntrack dropped to ~8k after restarts; controller-manager cpu still a bit high but not thrashing.

owen: etcd leader stable for ~2 election windows, no 503s in last 2m. logs still being trended.

karthik: cost impact: cross-region fallback will add estimated ~$2.5k/day while active. flagging for finance.

infra-oncall: keeping fallback until GPU onboarding backlog drains, aiming to re-evaluate at 02:40UTC. thanks all :thumbsup: 

maria: will follow up w/ a PR to raise conntrack default and add a rate-limit guard in the provisioner to avoid future attach spikes.
